title: fix(studio): pin the object extension, hook, action and flow Saves' publish (#36726)
body:
Fixes #36726
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设计器里保存对象扩展、钩子、动作和流程时，若别人刚发布过同一项，现在会弹出与对象页相同的冲突提示，不再静默覆盖对方。
- 这是对象页已修好的"两人同时保存后者静默覆盖"问题（父卡已关闭）在其余四种编辑器上的补全。
- 出错时最坏是多问一次冲突提示，不会丢数据；纯前端改动，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Each Studio editor that saves by "write the draft, then publish that one item" now pins its publish to the published row it was loaded at, the way the object page does since #36720. The server half (If-Match / If-None-Match on publish, `overlayVersion` on `/layers`) is already on main.

Per-site verdicts (line numbers at the dispatch base 844218f5):

| Site | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:6884` object extension Save | pinned. The load reads `/layers` at the pair BEFORE the draft and body reads (version first, the server's own order), records it with `recordPublished`, and the Save passes the guard's `publish`. A buffer read at another package records `If-None-Match: *` at the pair. |
| `:8913` new flow create | `If-None-Match: *` through a new `publishCreated` helper: a same-named flow another writer published first is refused, never replaced. No dialog: the refusal is the create's own. |
| `:9095` flow Save | pinned, same version-first load; the `/layers` read is shared with the baseline read when they hit the same address. Customize-into-pair branch records `*` at the pair. |
| `:9240` flow on/off switch | pinned through the same guard; a flip over a flow another writer published is asked about. |
| `objectHooksBuffer.ts:365` hook Save | pinned. The list load reads each listed hook's `/layers` at the package; a published hook with no pending draft is buffered from that same answer when it pins, so pin and body are one read. A new hook records `*`. |
| `pairObjectActions.ts:404` pair action Save | pinned from the same `/layers` answer the buffer is already built from. A new row records `*`. |

Every editor handles the `reloaded` outcome the way the object page does (ruling 4): the Save is declined, the editor re-reads, its edits are dropped. Keep editing leaves the edits unsaved with the refusal shown. Dialog wording and locale keys from #36601 are reused unchanged; no new keys.

### The `hadDraft` reload residual (scope addition 7104420437)

Fix shape chosen: **keep the published pin the conflict was raised on until the author re-confirms**, in the guard (`DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, header rule 9). Why this one rather than "install the live row and leave the pending draft under Changes":

- one place: the guard owns both pins, so the object page and all five editors get it with no per-editor load change; the other shape needs every load to learn a second install mode;
- the other shape would make the next Save write the live body over the copilot's pending draft, which #36511 forbids discarding;
- re-confirmation already exists: the dialog's overwrite (with its confirm step) is it.

Mechanics: `beforeReload` now answers `kept` when the Save wrote into a draft that was pending before it (`discarded` otherwise). On `kept`, the reload's fresh `recordPublished` is parked instead of applied, and the next publish still carries the version the conflict was raised on, so the next Save is asked again. The hold ends on an overwrite, a publish that lands, a load that reads no pending draft (`recordRead` with `*`), or `forget`.

## Tests

New files, each named for this card (keep editing, reload, overwrite, one editor's pins chain, create asserts `*`, unpinned control, plus the residual pin):

- `ObjectHooksPanel.publishPinned-36726.test.tsx` (7)
- `DataPillar.pairActionsPublishPinned-36726.test.tsx` (7)
- `AutomationsPillar.publishPinned-36726.test.tsx` (incl. the switch)
- `DataPillar.extensionPublishPinned-36726.test.tsx`

Appended: the guard's rule 9 unit tests in `DraftConflictDialog.test.tsx`; the object page's residual pin in `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773.test.tsx` (AGENTS.md puts a new pin in the existing harness that already models that surface; the dispatch asked for new files; I followed AGENTS.md for those two and say so here).

Stale fixtures updated (the create/pair publish now asserts `*`): `DataPillar.pairActions-30088`, `AutomationsPillar.saveCancel-36511`, `AutomationsPillar.customizeFlow-28570`; `StudioDesignSurface.expectedMisses-11799` (an unsaved flow now reads `/layers` once, for its pin).

Ablation (implementation files restored to origin/main d9c799c10, tests kept; restored by `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, all five blob hashes re-matched): 31 of 78 tests red across all 6 files, every red is a race or residual pin, no control among them; 47 green including each file's control.

## Acceptance notes

- Hooks and flows with a pending draft: the pin and the draft are read in parallel/sequence, not in one read. A publish landing in that window leaves the pin older than the buffer, so the next Save is asked; it can never overwrite. Safe direction only.
- Hooks without a pending draft now take their body from the `/layers` answer when it pins (exact pairing), from the list otherwise.
- Out of this card and NOT fixed (still unpinned, reported for the seat): OWD overview Save (`PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx:487`), object create (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~6697), permission Save (~10962), new app door (`newAppDoor.ts:72`).
- No contract change; no L2 contract review owed by this diff (ui only, no spec/server/locale change).
